data.title: 奥萝拉 · 圣域白石残垣上的指尖相触
data.description: 虚空浮岛的白色古代残垣边缘，狂风掀起深绯色高开衩长裙。奥萝拉斜倚在白石上，纤长手指轻触在暗影唇角，神秘紫眸满含戏谑与依恋。
data.location: floating white marble ancient sanctuary ruins suspended over a vast glowing nebula void
data.action: leaning back against broken marble column in high-slit crimson gown, touching Shadow cheek with slender pale fingers, sultry amused smile
data.lighting: ethereal purple aurora luminescence washing over long black hair and pale skin
data.mood: intoxicating ancient mystique, sultry playful intimacy, fated mutual understanding
data.promptProse: On a floating marble ruin in void, long black-haired witch Aurora in crimson slit dress touches someone cheek with a sultry smile.
data.animaCaption: Aurora leans against the marble and touches the corner of the viewer's lips.
